csv_scope_of_work: The Terrell County Board of Commissioners requests qualifications from interested Energy Services Companies (ESCO's) for the design and implementation of a Guaranteed Energy Savings Performance Contract in various facilities. This Request for Qualifications requires the selected ESCO to conduct an investment grade audit. The selected ESCO will be required to identify, engineer, design, install, maintain, and provide financing options for approved energy conservation measures in a fixed cost scenario. The intent of this project is to provide the Terrell County Board of Commissioners with the means to improve their designated facilities through guaranteed energy, operationa!, maintenance and capital cost avoidance savings, as well as new revenue sources.
